_comment: Party ids used across every source adapter. 'match' lists lowercase labels/codes that map to the id. Mark colours: only DEM, IND and GOP get categorical hues (validated with the dataviz skill's validate_palette.js on #161b22 and #0e1116, seat-bar order D, I, R: all checks pass). Minor parties fold into the neutral 'other' mark and are always identified by a text label. Re-run the validator before changing any of these.

caucus._comment: Independents who caucus with a party count toward that party's seat total.
